今日はとても良い天気でした


Translate the following Japanese text to English:

thoughts.subject: Interpreting a Japanese Phrase
thoughts.description:
\n\n

I've successfully translated the Japanese phrase "今日はとても良い天気でした" into "The weather was very nice today." Simple and straightforward, as I suspected it would be. Now, I'm ready for the next step, whatever that may be.
